item.summary: The president highlights how Tehran is selling drones to Moscow that have been used against Ukraine.

item.summary: Civilians who remain despite evacuation orders in Tyre – some unable to move, others defiant - are trying to continue their daily routines next to bomb sites.

item.title: Who wants what from the Iran war?

item.title: What Iranians are being told about the war
item.summary: Iranian state media's coverage of the war includes inflations of enemy casualties and digital manipulation intended to glorify Iran.
